items.statement: For \(n\ge3\), \(\kappa\ge4\), \(\ell\ge0\), let \(A_O=\frac{\kappa+1}{2}I_n-\frac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^\top)\), \(\mu\) be normalized full real orthogonal Haar, \(\nu_\pm=2\mu|_{\{\det O=\pm1\}}\), \(\gamma_O=\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\), \(P_\pm=\nu_\pm\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}\gamma\), and \(p_O(x)=\frac{\sqrt{\det A_O}}{(2\pi)^{n/2}}e^{-x^\top A_Ox/2}\) on Euclidean volume. Set \(t(x)=e^{-\ell\|x\|^2}\) and \(H(\ell)=\int\det(O)\int t(x)p_O(x)\,dx\,d\mu(O)\). Then \(2|H(\ell)|\le\sup_{B\ \mathrm{measurable}}|P_+(B)-P_-(B)|\). Includes zero tilt; all actual law, probability, L1 and supremum conditions are internal.
assumptions: \(\mu\) is normalized Haar on full real \(O(n)\), \(\nu_\pm=2\mu|_{\{\det O=\pm1\}}\), and \(P_\pm=\nu_\pm\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}\gamma\) with the actual \(\gamma_O=\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\).
\(p_O\) is the actual normalized density relative to Euclidean volume. All integrals are real Bochner integrals; absolute integrability and actual law identities are proved internally.
TV uses the supremum over measurable events, with no extra factor of two. Measurability, probability laws and the event supremum conditions are produced inside the proof.
